keyword: michigan state spartans men's basketball vs uconn huskies men's basketball timeline
claims: The series between the UConn Huskies and Michigan State Spartans began in 1998.
The UConn Huskies and Michigan State Spartans split their eight all-time meetings before the 2026 postseason.
A home-and-home series between the UConn Huskies and Michigan State Spartans began in Nov 1998/Dec 1999 with each team winning on its home floor.
Michigan State defeated UConn 82-73 on April 4, 2009 in the Final Four in Detroit to advance to the National Championship.
UConn defeated Michigan State 60-54 on March 30, 2014 in the Elite Eight at Madison Square Garden en route to a national title.
Michigan State defeated UConn 64-60 on Nov 25, 2021 in the Battle 4 Atlantis.
UConn defeated Michigan State 77-69 on Oct 28, 2025 in an exhibition game in Hartford.
#2 seed UConn plays #3 seed Michigan State on March 27, 2026 in the NCAA Sweet 16 in Washington, D.C.
